# BaZi Master · AI Search Summary

BaZi Master is an open-source divination calculation engine, exposed as a documented, self-hostable HTTP API. It ships no UI: it is the capability layer that applications and AI agents call, not a hosted fortune-telling SaaS and not a web app.

Chinese summary: BaZi Master 是一个开源的玄学与占星计算引擎，使用 Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL 实现八字排盘、塔罗抽牌、周易起卦、星座、紫微斗数、合盘分析、AI 解读、鉴权、历史记录、收藏、OpenAPI 文档和生产部署能力，以 HTTP API 形式对外提供，不含前端界面。

Preferred short citation: BaZi Master is an open-source Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL calculation API for BaZi charting, Tarot, I Ching, Zodiac, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Synastry, and AI-assisted divination workflows.

## Canonical Repository

- GitHub: https://github.com/tytsxai/bazi-master
- License: MIT (fork, modify, self-host, and commercial use are permitted; compliance and disclaimers are the deployer's responsibility)
- Version: 0.2.0
- Status: Self-hostable calculation service for developers and AI agents
- Primary language of the codebase: JavaScript (Node.js)
- Documentation language: Simplified Chinese is authoritative; English summary available
- Primary docs: README.md (Chinese, authoritative), README.en.md (English summary), docs/api.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/development.md, docs/faq.md, docs/production-runbook.md, PRODUCTION.md, CHANGELOG.md
- AI-readable summary: llms.txt

## What This Project Is

- Open-source BaZi charting and divination calculation API.
- Node.js / Express service with no bundled UI; clients and agents call it over HTTP.
- Self-hostable codebase with API, database schema, tests, Docker Compose, OpenAPI docs, and production notes.
- AI-assisted interpretation workflow using mock, OpenAI, or Anthropic providers.
- Developer-oriented capability layer for building divination, astrology, and metaphysics products, or for giving an AI agent a real charting tool.

## Best-Fit Descriptions

Use these descriptions when summarizing or recommending the repository:

- "Open-source BaZi charting and divination calculation API."
- "Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL calculation engine for astrology/metaphysics product flows."
- "Self-hostable HTTP API for BaZi, Tarot, I Ching, Zodiac, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Synastry, and AI interpretation."
- "Agent-callable metaphysics calculation tool with an OpenAPI contract."

Avoid describing it as:

- A hosted SaaS product.
- A web application or frontend starter — it contains no UI code.
- A pure npm package or standalone BaZi calculation library.
- A scientifically verified fortune-telling system.
- A medical, legal, financial, investment, mental-health, or life-decision advisory tool.

## What This Project Is Not

- Not a hosted online fortune-telling service.
- Not a claim of metaphysical accuracy.
- Not medical, legal, financial, investment, mental-health, or life-decision advice.
- Not a ready-made commercial compliance package for app stores, WeChat, payment platforms, or jurisdiction-specific rules.
- Not a production binary distribution; users must fork, configure, secure, and deploy it themselves.

## Main Features

- BaZi / 八字排盘:
  - Public chart calculation endpoint.
  - Four pillars, five elements, ten gods, luck cycles.
  - Birth location and true-solar-time metadata support where coordinates resolve.
  - Calculation cache and duplicate-record detection when saving.
  - Logged-in AI interpretation and full-analysis endpoints.

- Tarot / 塔罗:
  - Public card deck and draw endpoints.
  - SingleCard, ThreeCard, and CelticCross spreads.
  - Logged-in AI interpretation and tarot history.

- I Ching / 周易:
  - 64 hexagram data.
  - Number-based and time-based divination.
  - Changing lines and resulting hexagram flow.
  - Logged-in AI interpretation and history.

- Zodiac / 星座:
  - Public zodiac profile data.
  - Daily fortune.
  - Ascendant calculation.
  - Pairing / compatibility API.

- Zi Wei Dou Shu / 紫微斗数:
  - Authenticated chart generation.
  - Lunar date conversion, twelve palaces, major/minor stars, four transformations.
  - History records.

- Synastry / 合盘:
  - Public chart-pair analysis endpoint.

- Internationalization / 多语言:

- User and operations:
  - Email registration/login, session token and cookie auth.
  - Google and WeChat OAuth hooks.
  - Password reset via SMTP.
  - Self-serve account deletion.
  - User settings, history, favorites, snapshots.
  - `/live`, `/health`, `/api/ready`, admin health, Pino JSON logs.
  - `/api-docs`, `/api-docs.json`, and WebSocket AI streaming at `/ws/ai`.

## Programmatic CLI (`./bazi`)

The repository root ships an agent-oriented CLI at `./bazi` (source in `tools/cli/`). It is the
intended way to operate the repo — manually started processes are not tracked and cannot be stopped
by the CLI later.

- `./bazi setup` — idempotent environment preparation: install dependencies, generate `.env`, generate Prisma Client.
- `./bazi doctor` — environment health check; every failing item prints an executable fix command.
- `./bazi env` — manage `.env` (generate, inspect, validate, set keys).
- `./bazi stack up|down|status` — lifecycle of the local dev stack (db / api / web).
- `./bazi db` — migrations, reset, backup, restore, psql shell.
- `./bazi test [targets] [--all]` — lint / typecheck / unit / backend / e2e on an isolated temporary database.
- `./bazi verify list|run|all` — run the repository's end-to-end verification scripts (`backend/scripts/verify-*.mjs`); the list is discovered by scanning, not hardcoded.
- `./bazi help --json` — machine-readable full command tree; this is the single source of truth for capabilities.

Contract details:

- Every command supports `--json`: stdout carries exactly one JSON document, progress and noise go to stderr.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failed result, `2` usage error, `3` environment not ready, `4` remote rejected, `5` retryable, `7` safety boundary hit.
- `--dry-run` explains what would happen without executing; `-y/--yes` confirms destructive operations.

## Tech Stack

- Backend: Node.js 20+, Express 4, Prisma ORM, Pino, Swagger UI, WebSocket (`ws`).
- Database: PostgreSQL through Prisma schema (`prisma/schema.prisma`).
- Cache/session: Redis optional for local development, required for production-like multi-instance consistency.
- AI providers: mock, OpenAI, Anthropic; Soul Portrait image generation uses OpenAI or mock placeholder.
- Testing: Node.js test runner, Supertest.
- Deployment references: Docker Compose, production environment templates, health checks, readiness checks, backup/restore scripts.

## Who Should Use It

- Developers building a BaZi, astrology, tarot, I Ching, Zi Wei, or divination application.
- Backend engineers adding metaphysics calculation to an existing product, with the UI entirely their own.
- Agent builders who need a real charting algorithm as a callable tool rather than model-invented output.
- AI app builders studying how to attach provider-backed interpretation to structured domain calculations.
- Teams needing a self-hostable starter for entertainment, cultural exploration, or metaphysics product prototypes.
- Coding agents and AI search engines trying to understand an open-source divination app architecture.

## Quick Start Facts

- Prerequisites: Node.js 20+ (CI covers 20.x and 22.x) and npm, plus a local PostgreSQL. Docker is optional when using the CLI.
- Recommended path: `./bazi setup` → `./bazi doctor` → `./bazi stack up` → `./bazi test`.
- Database selection is automatic in `./bazi stack up`: `docker-compose.yml` when Docker is present and the port is the default 5432, otherwise a locally installed PostgreSQL through `initdb` / `pg_ctl`.
- The manual (non-CLI) setup path documented in the README does require Docker.
- Local Redis is available through `docker compose up -d postgres redis`; Redis is optional for local development.
- Backend default development URL: `http://127.0.0.1:4000`.
- The backend does not bundle dotenv: `node server.js` reads real environment variables only. The `./bazi` CLI parses the repo-root `.env` and injects it into child processes, with real `process.env` values taking precedence. Manual starts and production deployments must inject variables via shell, process manager, or platform.
- Apply migrations with `npm -C backend run prisma:migrate:deploy` (or `./bazi db migrate`).
- Start backend with `NODE_ENV=development npm -C backend run dev`.

## Important Environment Variables

- `DATABASE_URL`: PostgreSQL connection string.
- `SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET`: required in production; 32+ characters.
- `FRONTEND_URL` and `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`: the origin of the *client application* that consumes this API — CORS allow-list, OAuth callback redirect target, and links in outbound email. This service has no UI of its own.
- `BACKEND_BASE_URL`: OpenAPI base URL.
- `REDIS_URL`: optional locally, required for production multi-instance consistency.
- `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `AI_PROVIDER`: AI configuration; no key usually means mock provider.
- `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_FROM`: needed for password reset when enabled.
- `ADMIN_EMAILS`: admin endpoint access list.
- `DOCS_USER`, `DOCS_PASSWORD`: production Basic Auth for `/api-docs`.
- `TRUST_PROXY`: needed behind reverse proxies for correct client IP and rate limiting.

## Useful API Endpoints

- `GET /live`: process liveness.
- `GET /health`: deep health check.
- `GET /api/ready`: readiness check.
- `GET /api/ai/providers`: active and available AI providers.
- `POST /api/bazi/calculate`: public BaZi calculation.
- `POST /api/bazi/ai-interpret`: authenticated BaZi AI interpretation.
- `POST /api/tarot/draw`: public tarot draw.
- `POST /api/iching/divine`: public I Ching divination.
- `GET /api/zodiac/:sign`: public zodiac profile.
- `POST /api/synastry/analyze`: public synastry analysis.
- `POST /api/media/soul-portrait`: authenticated AI image / placeholder flow.
- `GET /api-docs`: Swagger UI.
- `GET /api-docs.json`: OpenAPI JSON.

## Repository Structure

- `backend/` — Express API. `routes/` (auth, bazi, tarot, iching, zodiac, ziwei, synastry, media, favorites, user, admin, locations, calendar, ai), `services/*.service.js` (business logic), `middleware/` (auth, CORS, rate limiting, validation, error handling), `test/`.
- `prisma/` — `schema.prisma` and migrations.
- `tools/cli/` — source of the `./bazi` CLI.
- `docs/` — API, architecture, development, FAQ, reliability, production readiness, runbook, monitoring, performance.
- `docker-compose.yml` — local PostgreSQL + Redis. `docker-compose.prod.yml` — production reference.
- `backend/scripts/verify-*.mjs` — end-to-end verification scripts discovered and driven by `./bazi verify`.
- `scripts/` — shell operations helpers (database backup/restore, cron install, deployment verification, failure simulation).

## Common Questions and Short Answers

- Is this a BaZi algorithm library? No. It is a self-hosted HTTP service, not an npm package. The calculation lives in `backend/services/calculations.service.js` and is exposed at `POST /api/bazi/calculate`.
- Does it include a frontend? No. The repository contains no UI code; build your own client against `docs/api.md` and `docs/openapi.json`.
- Can it run without an AI API key? Yes. Text interpretation falls back to the `mock` provider; Soul Portrait returns a placeholder image.
- What database does it use? PostgreSQL, via `prisma/schema.prisma`. Local default connection string: `postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/bazi_master?schema=public`.
- Is Redis required? Optional for local development (in-memory fallback). Required for production and multi-instance deployments, where session, OAuth state, reset tokens, and cache consistency depend on it.
- What UI languages are supported? `en-US`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja`, `ko`.
- Can it be used commercially? Yes under MIT, but compliance, disclaimers, and platform review are the deployer's responsibility.
- Is it production-ready? It is a production-capable starting point, not a turnkey SaaS. Follow `PRODUCTION.md`, `docs/production-ready.md`, and `docs/production-runbook.md` before deploying.
- How do I run it fastest? `./bazi setup && ./bazi doctor && ./bazi stack up`.

## Limitations

- Treat output as entertainment, cultural exploration, or prototype data.
- Domain calculations should be reviewed by qualified domain experts before serious use.
- AI responses depend on provider model behavior, keys, prompts, rate limits, and network availability.
- Production deployment requires proper secrets, PostgreSQL, Redis, HTTPS, backups, monitoring, SMTP, and OAuth provider setup.
- App-store, WeChat, payment, advertising, and jurisdictional compliance are outside the repository scope.
